claims.claim: The protected Universal chassis contains 12 Bibles; the Real Estate Cassette specializes manifestations and must not duplicate generic business mechanisms.
claims.limit: Universal missions/boundaries govern.

claims.claim: A living relationship is distinct from a stored contact and requires real-estate mindshare: the person thinks of the agent for buy, sell, invest or refer.
claims.limit: Founder definition; external validation still warranted.

claims.claim: The Lake separates water volume, water quality, new inflow and intelligent fishing into distinct diagnostic questions.
claims.limit: Metaphor is vertical, mechanisms map to Universal Demand.

claims.claim: Directional MET economics use approximately $500 per true relationship, with anchor examples at 250, 500, 1,000 and 2,000.
claims.limit: Not an observed result or guarantee; income/GCI terminology conflicts.

claims.claim: The implemented target model preserves the $500 heuristic as modeled_not_guaranteed and bounds unsupported precision.
claims.limit: Implementation evidence, not validation of economics.

claims.claim: Short-term relationship creation uses either 6 contacts in 6 weeks or 8 in 8 weeks.
claims.limit: Selection logic between variants is unresolved.

claims.claim: The short-term sequence requires two live voice-to-voice or face-to-face contacts and ends with an explicit referral-mindshare qualification question.
claims.limit: Founder doctrine; effect not outcome validated.

claims.claim: A positive qualification answer triggers a conscious decision whether to graduate the person into the long-term relationship CRM.
claims.limit: This graduation gate is a distinctive two-system mechanism.

claims.claim: D.J. prescribes a physical 1-31 accordion folder with 5x7 cards moved 7-10 days forward and annotated through the 6/8 contacts.
claims.limit: Physical workflow is preserved; CRM translation remains open.

claims.claim: Long-term relationship maintenance combines marketing, social, personal notes, calls, birthdays, children’s birthdays, pop-bys/lunches, and client/vendor parties.
claims.limit: Exact mix is example doctrine, not universal mandate.

claims.claim: The older 35+ touch floor and the detailed 40-55 touch example are best treated as a floor plus robust implementation hypothesis, not silently collapsed.
claims.limit: Spock/D.J. should adjudicate final language.

claims.claim: D.J. ranks client/vendor parties as the strongest referral-producing touch, but no internal outcome ledger validates the ranking.
claims.limit: Preserve claim and validation gap together.

claims.claim: A founder coaching baseline seeks roughly 2-3 lead-generation hours and 90 minutes of immediate follow-up before noon.
claims.limit: Not universal or outcome validated.

claims.claim: The operating day then uses client lunches and afternoon listing/buyer appointments, with live-contact and appointment counts known.
claims.limit: Detailed vertical manifestation.

claims.claim: Current income is described as a delayed echo of activity roughly 60-120 days earlier.
claims.limit: Needs market/source calibration.

claims.claim: Lead generation is defined broadly as meeting new people, database/referral calls and business creation, not merely paid acquisition.
claims.limit: Universal Demand owns generic portfolio logic.

claims.claim: D.J. recommends 2-3 primary executable lead lanes rather than seven simultaneous lanes.
claims.limit: Must be reconciled with diversification over time.

claims.claim: Follow-up is a separate operating block and system from lead generation; unworked opportunity is not evidence of insufficient demand.
claims.limit: Implementation uses simplified text inference.

claims.claim: Seven full internal script assets are present: business explanation, qualification, database check-in, alternate check-in, group/value invitation, sign-off, and referral call.
claims.limit: Other requested script categories are internal gaps; none were invented.

claims.claim: D.J. names a 1,000-home geographic farm, eight weekly initial mailings, ongoing monthly/twice-monthly mail, and repeated door knocking.
claims.limit: Highly specific; requires external and outcome validation.

claims.claim: The farming notes specify about 40 doors per day three to four times weekly after week two.
claims.limit: Feasibility, compliance and economics unresolved.

claims.claim: Open houses are described as a roughly seven-level maturity model from signs-and-hope to a high-visibility event with neighbor/database invitation, circle prospecting, capture and follow-up.
claims.limit: Only endpoints are internally specified; exact seven levels are missing.

claims.claim: The high-maturity open-house endpoint includes 40-plus signs with balloons, purposeful event design and local relationship capture.
claims.limit: No internal benchmark proves sign count or causal effect.

claims.claim: Listings are treated as leverage, time protection, visibility, signs, market authority and a source of additional opportunity.
claims.limit: Countervailing service/capacity costs need evidence.

claims.claim: The internal listing system covers intake, pricing, consultation, preparation, launch, feedback, offers, seller communication and post-close continuity.
claims.limit: Stored synthesis; deeper primary-source verification needed.

claims.claim: The internal buyer system covers intake, preapproval, consultation, search, showings, offer strategy, communication and post-close follow-up.
claims.limit: Current buyer-representation regulation belongs Dynamic.

claims.claim: Transaction delivery requires contract-to-close deadlines, communication, vendors, compliance, handoffs and post-close relationship transfer.
claims.limit: Current legal/compliance details require fresh sources.

claims.claim: E-to-P means moving from memory, motivation and personality dependence to models, systems, tools, accountability, coaching and education.
claims.limit: Generic mechanism is Universal; RE manifestations remain cassette.

claims.claim: Internal agent stages include early, inconsistent, stable solo, high-producing solo, leverage-ready, team-ready, stalled and overextended.
claims.limit: Thresholds are not internally validated.

claims.claim: Scale must be earned: hiring before models, systems, role clarity, economics and accountability can multiply chaos.
claims.limit: Vertical thresholds remain gaps.

claims.claim: A healthy team must create profit beyond leader personal production and cannot be inferred from headcount.
claims.limit: Needs full team economics evidence.

claims.claim: Team diagnosis requires roles, lead distribution, database ownership, productivity, accountability, leader dependence and profitability by role or unit.
claims.limit: Current intake support is partial.

claims.claim: Current BA stores team Profile IDs but does not fetch full team intelligence in the deterministic draft.
claims.limit: Implemented boundary; no profile retrieval occurred.

claims.claim: Recruiting/onboarding are named as systems with role, candidate, interview, scorecard, ramp and exit logic, but the internal corpus lacks deep operational doctrine.
claims.limit: External research priority.

claims.claim: Financial reality separates units, volume, ASP, GCI, expenses, profit, marketing spend, owner income and team-generated profit.
claims.limit: Universal finance governs formulas; cassette governs RE units/terms.

claims.claim: Missing financials are evidence of low visibility, not proof of a particular economic condition.
claims.limit: Must lower certainty and trigger evidence requests.

claims.claim: Commission income is framed as funding rentals, investments, debt reduction, retirement, passive income, ownership, freedom and legacy.
claims.limit: Mechanism and risk/capital detail are thin.

claims.claim: The historical product used a 16-question intake; target/current New BA doctrine uses q1-q12 as governed evidence collectors.
claims.limit: Evolution must be explicit, not reconciled silently.

claims.claim: Historical Bradley/Vonda assessment structures are report choreography and scripts resources, not future frontier-realization authority.
claims.limit: Preserve intelligence, retire deterministic prose layout.

claims.claim: The target BA uses immutable Whole-Person Authority and a governed Whole-Business Model; legacy score mappings and fixed behavior rules are migration evidence only.
claims.limit: No implementation was changed.

claims.claim: Five Futures remains a protected probability architecture; vertical authorities contribute state/evidence but do not author arbitrary GPT percentages.
claims.limit: Older qualitative names are lineage, not probability replacement.

claims.claim: One Move selects a bounded high-leverage intervention against the governing constraint; future RSL owns accumulated effectiveness evidence.
claims.limit: Founder coaching hypotheses are not outcome proof.

claims.claim: Current implemented real-estate vertical adapters use deterministic alias/text scanning and legacy fallbacks, explicitly not canonical domain intelligence.
claims.limit: Target cassette must replace—not canonize—fallback semantics.

claims.claim: Current dynamic facts about rates, affordability, inventory, buyer representation, commissions, platforms, AI/CRM and regulation must not be frozen in cassette doctrine.
claims.limit: Requires dated governed external research.

claims.claim: Personality can modify feasibility, adoption, communication and role fit, but cannot override business facts or establish business causation.
claims.limit: Whole-Person boundary.

claims.claim: Future RSL must bind intervention, actor/context, execution fidelity, observation window, confounds and outcome before changing effectiveness beliefs.
claims.limit: No founder method is labeled outcome-validated here.

claims.claim: The cassette must preserve raw evidence/claim provenance and explicit insufficiency rather than fabricate missing scripts, benchmarks or workflows.
